ci-bot: :rotating_light: nightly-perf alert — p95 latency +28% vs baseline for small-batch profile (model=starling-7b, seq=128). job=nightly-perf/2026-03-17-77. artifacts: https://ci.redwood/artefacts/nightly/2026-03-17-77 (flamegraph + logs)
marina: saw the alert, thanks. marking this high-priority. can someone grab the flamegraph and check alloc patterns? assigning to @eng-runtime-oncall
eng-runtime-oncall: on it. pulling artifacts now, starting with flamegraphs. marina do you have the commit/PR that triggered this nightly run?
marina: commit abc1234 (merge PR #482) — small kv-cache eviction change landed yesterday. test id: nightly-2026-03-17-77
nitin: kv-cache eviction tweak could explain a tail increase if we changed eviction threshold. also, did the nightly run hit any new kernel updates on the hosts? cpu steal or OOMs could show up in the runner logs.
sasha: re-ran the critical scenario locally (single-node, seq=128, batch=1) using the same commit — I see p95 bump ~25% reproducible. quick repro command I used:
```
make run-bench BENCH=scenario_small_batch MODEL=starling-7b SEQ=128 BATCH=1
```
output: p50 34ms -> 36ms, p95 120ms -> 152ms
liam: if it's reproducible locally we can bisect. marina can you queue a rerun with kvcache disabled? e.g. KVCACHE_EVICT=0 env to confirm
marina: queued a manual rerun with KVCACHE_EVICT=0 and the same seed. CI link: https://ci.redwood/builds/1773890123-rerun-1
ci-bot: rerun queued: nightly-perf/1773890123-rerun-1. status: queued
eng-runtime-oncall: flamegraphs attached in artifacts (flame_small_batch.svg). quick scan — more cycles in the attention kernel and increased memcpy activity around step ~210. attaching host sample list: host-03, host-07, host-11
nitin: memcpy spikes could be due to changed kvcache layout forcing more host<->device transfers. can you check the allocator logs for increased buffer churn? also plz paste the allocator summary from the run (allocs/sec, avg lifetime)
sasha: allocator summary snippet from logs (trimmed):
"allocs/sec=2400, avg_lifetime_ms=18.7, eviction_ops=340"
liam: marina i'll start a local bisect (halving commits between last green and this) unless someone else wants it. also request to infra: can ops check for node kernel/scheduler updates on host-03/07/11 in the time window 03/17 02:00-03:30? @ops
marina: ops pinged (DM sent). eng-runtime-oncall — can you capture a kernel profile (perf record) on host-07 in the next repro? I'll coordinate access.
eng-runtime-oncall: yes, will capture perf and nvprof on the next run. also enabling debug allocator logging for one cycle to capture churn.
nitin: if debug logging adds noise maybe capture a single critical iteration with debug on, not whole run.
sasha: agreed. i'll run an instrumented iteration locally and upload flame for that single iteration.
marina: thanks — plan for next 24h: 1) perf + nvprof capture on host-07 2) bisect PR range if local bisect confirms 3) rerun with KVCACHE_EVICT=0 result will tell us if eviction is culprit 4) if still unclear, run with kernel profiler and collect allocator traces. assigning followups: @liam bisect, @eng-runtime-oncall perf capture, @sasha single-iter instrumented flame, @nitin analysis.
liam: taking bisect. ETA ~3-4 hours, will post progress here. :thumbsup:
eng-runtime-oncall: perf capture scheduled, will include cpu+gpu timeline and memcpy markers. I'll upload links when ready.
marina: beautiful — please paste artifacts here when available. thanks all, appreciate the quick response :pray:
sasha: uploading single-iter flamegraph: https://ci.redwood/artefacts/nightly/2026-03-17-77/single_iter_flame.svg — looks similar to main flame but with clearer memcpy hotspots
nitin: thanks — retaining hypothesis: kvcache eviction change increased host-device traffic -> memcpy hotspots -> higher p95. lets confirm with KVCACHE_EVICT=0 rerun and perf traces
marina: branch scheduled: will update with next status. if anyone wants access to the runner logs DM me.
liam: bisect update: narrowed to two commits (abc000..abc123). running final differential test now.
eng-runtime-oncall: perf + nvprof artifacts uploaded: https://ci.redwood/artefacts/nightly/2026-03-17-77/perf_nvprof_bundle.zip
marina: grabbing and sharing with infra for cross-check. good work team.
sasha: :thumbsup:
ci-bot: note — alert cleared for nightly-perf/2026-03-17-77 (investigation ongoing).
